A warm welcome to Peter Hills CE Primary School
Welcome to Peter Hills Church of England Primary School, part of the Partnership with St. Jude's and St Peter's. Together we 'Break Barriers with God in life, learning and love'.
We are a small and nurturing Church of England primary school in the heart of Rotherhithe, where every child is known, valued and encouraged to flourish. As part of a vibrant and diverse local community, we are proud to offer an education that combines strong academic foundations with a caring, Christian ethos.
At our school, we believe that every child is unique and created with purpose. Guided by our Christian values, we aim to provide a safe, supportive and inclusive environment where children feel confident to explore, take risks and develop a lifelong love of learning. Our vision is to nurture the whole child—academically, socially and spiritually—so that they grow into compassionate, resilient and respectful individuals.
We place great importance on strong relationships between pupils, staff, families and the wider community. Being a small school allows us to truly know our children as individuals and support them in reaching their full potential.
Located in historic Rotherhithe, an area known for its strong sense of community and rich heritage , we are proud to play a central role in local life. Our school is a place where children feel happy, safe and inspired every day.
